subject.why: Contains the card, fingerprint, brush, and powder tin as briefed.

category.why: Follows the two-tone surface and wall backdrop requirements.

clean.why: Free of UI, text, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: Composition is split into loose separate pieces rather than one cohesive central silhouette.

colour.why: Tones are muted and cool rather than warm, rich, and juicy.

detail.why: Detail level is controlled with simple primary shapes.

style.why: Smooth shading matches the game's clean casual 3D look.

bg_colour.why: background is grey/dark (60% of the background); the plan asks for purple

fix: Make the background purple: Plain soft violet-purple flat surface and a smooth purple wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.. Group the tin closely against the card into a single solid silhouette and boost overall color saturation.
